entry.title: Organize production MMIS services by domain package
entry.description: After a validated MMIS operation becomes a reusable production Query, Reader, Linker, Store, or Orchestrator, organize it under a domain package instead of retaining a filename that describes the original diagnostic CLI operation.
applicable_when: A connector has multiple validated operations in the same MMIS domain
Diagnostic entrypoints have been separated from production runtime code
Renaming internal modules while preserving package-level APIs and executable contracts
advantages: Makes production ownership and responsibility clear
Prevents unbounded growth of query_<full-operation-description>.py modules
Allows development tools to retain discoverable operation names without shaping production architecture
disadvantages: Requires coordinated import, test, documentation, and architecture-inventory updates
Direct consumers of undocumented internal module paths must migrate
recommended_when: The production execution closure and public package API are already documented and tested
notes: Prefer domain/query.py, domain/reader.py, domain/linker.py, and application/orchestrator.py or store.py.
Keep executable development tools named after the concrete operation they perform.
Use real moves, preserve class names and package-level exports, and compare non-import AST plus regression tests to prove behavior preservation.
Do not retain forwarding shims unless the old internal module path is an explicit compatibility contract.
